ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_contrastive_001_advantage
ir.intuition: Use a contrastive paradigm with advantage signals to encourage higher margin between preferred and non-preferred sequences, applying a softplus on negative advantage-weighted log probability gaps to create a smooth, hinge-like penalty emphasizing confident ranking with margin.
ir.pseudocode:
advantage_weighted_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
margin = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * advantage_weighted_gap
loss = mean(softplus(-margin) * weight)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), adv_gap)
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(margin)), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)
